title: Fool‘s Rite
gallery_text: This Project is an immersive interactive environment composed of multimedia installations. The project creates a space for “useless” dwelling and explores how individuals can coexist with their non-functional selves rather than being pushed toward constant restoration of function.

answers.interest: I’m interested in combining computational design, AI, and interaction to explore how data can shape spatial experiences.
answers.suggestions: Still in the process of figuring it out.
